scripts.text:
[Noi]
Welcome to Ayothaya.
Our beautiful village is built
above the water, surrounded
by a dense forest.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
歡迎來到哎喲泰雅。
我們美麗的村莊建在水面上，四周環繞著茂密的森林。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
There are many tourist attractions in this village that you won't be able to find anywhere else. Our fish markets and the unique architecture of our buildings are enough reason to visit Ayotaya.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
村裡有許多別處見不到的景點。
光是魚市和獨特的建築風格，就值得您專程來哎喲泰雅一遊。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Please feel free
to take a look around.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
請盡情四處看看。

scripts.text: Building Locations.
scripts.translation: 檢視建築位置

scripts.text: Remove marks from mini-map.
scripts.translation: 移除小地圖示記

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Where would
you like to visit?
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
您想去哪裡參觀？

scripts.text: Weapon Shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 道具店

scripts.text: Tavern
scripts.translation: 酒館

scripts.text: Shrine
scripts.translation: 神廟

scripts.text: Fishing Spot
scripts.translation: 釣魚點

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Noi]
At our Weapon Shop,
you will find great weapons
favored by brave Ayothayan seafarers.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
我們的武器店裡，有勇敢的哎喲泰雅航海者喜愛的優質武器。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Our Weapon Shop
is located at ^55FF33+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
武器店位於小地圖上的^55FF33+^000000標記處。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
We Ayothayans always make sure we have everything we need before we go traveling. It never hurts to be prepared, doesn't it?
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
我們哎喲泰雅人出門旅行前，總會備齊所需物品。
有備無患，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Our Tool Shop
is located at ^3355FF+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
道具店位於小地圖上的^3355FF+^000000標記處。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
One of the basics of adventuring is gathering information, or at least that's what they say. You can meet people from all sorts of places in the Tavern. I'm sure you can learn something useful there.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
大家都說，收集情報是冒險的基本功之一。
酒館裡能遇見來自各地的人，我相信您一定能在那裡打聽到有用的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Of course, you must
drop by our Tavern.
It is located at ^00FF00+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
當然，別忘了到我們的酒館坐坐。
它位於小地圖上的^00FF00+^000000標記處。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
If you wish to pray to God, or achieve a state of peace in your mind, why don't you visit our Shrine? Even if it's just for sight-seeing, everyone is
welcome there.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
想向神明祈禱，或讓心靈平靜下來，不妨去神廟看看。
即使只是觀光，那裡也歡迎每一位訪客。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Our Shrine
is located at ^00FF00+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
神廟位於小地圖上的^00FF00+^000000標記處。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Since Ayothaya was built above the surface of the water and close to a beach, it's been a favorite spot for fishermen. Why don't you catch some fish for dinner at the Fishing Spot?
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
哎喲泰雅建在水面上，又靠近海灘，一直很受漁民喜愛。
不如去釣魚點釣幾條魚，準備晚餐？

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Our famous
Fishing Spot
is located at ^00FF00+^000000
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
我們著名的釣魚點，位於小地圖上的^00FF00+^000000標記處。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
If you wish to remove location marks on your mini-map, please select the 'Remove marks from mini-map' command from the menu.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
想清除小地圖上的地點標記，請在選單中選擇“移除小地圖示記”。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Alright...
I've removed all the
location marks from
your mini-map.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
好的...
小地圖上的地點標記已經全部移除了。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Please enjoy
your travels.
scripts.translation:
[諾伊]
祝您旅途愉快。
